title: Halloween Black Cherry Bourbon Smash
description: A dark cherry bourbon cocktail with fresh lemon and maple syrup for a Halloween gathering.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: 2 pitted cherries and a lemon twist for garnish
instructions:
1. Add bourbon, cherry juice, lemon juice and maple syrup to a shaker with ice.
  2. Shake for 10 to 15 seconds, then strain into a rocks glass filled with crushed ice.
  3. Garnish with pitted cherries and a lemon twist.
notes: If using sweetened cherry juice, begin with half the maple syrup and adjust after tasting. For a nonalcoholic version, replace bourbon with 2 oz chilled black tea and top with 1 oz soda water.
